steps.name: environment
steps.description: Prepare global environment: ensure workspace exists, validate sudo availability where required, verify node and npm are present and Node major version >=18. Optionally persist NODE_ENV=development to /etc/profile.d/node_env.sh when PERSIST_NODE_ENV=1; if /etc/profile.d is not writable emit a non-fatal warning so automation can continue. Provide actionable diagnostics when Node <18.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="${WORKSPACE:-/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/two-player-tic-tac-toe-30439-30448/backend}"
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE"
command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "node not found on PATH" >&2; exit 2; }
command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "npm not found on PATH" >&2; exit 3; }
NODE_V=$(node -v || true) && NPM_V=$(npm -v || true)
NODE_MAJOR=$(node -v | sed -E 's/^v([0-9]+).*/\1/' || echo 0)
if [ "${NODE_MAJOR:-0}" -lt 18 ]; then echo "Node.js >=18 required (found ${NODE_V:-unknown}, npm ${NPM_V:-unknown}). Please use the container's Node >=18 or install a suitable Node runtime." >&2; exit 4; fi
# Optional persistence: only write if PERSIST_NODE_ENV=1; tolerate read-only /etc
if [ "${PERSIST_NODE_ENV:-0}" != "0" ]; then TMP=$(mktemp) && cat >"$TMP" <<'EOF'
# exported by env-001 for development workflows; override per-step with NODE_ENV as needed
export NODE_ENV=development
EOF
  if command -v sudo >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    if sudo test -w /etc/profile.d 2>/dev/null || sudo test -f /etc/profile.d 2>/dev/null; then
      if ! sudo test -f /etc/profile.d/node_env.sh || ! sudo cmp -s "$TMP" /etc/profile.d/node_env.sh; then sudo install -m644 "$TMP" /etc/profile.d/node_env.sh; fi
    else
      echo "warning: /etc/profile.d not writable; skipping persistent NODE_ENV (PERSIST_NODE_ENV=1 requested)" >&2
    fi
  else
    echo "warning: sudo not available; skipping persistent NODE_ENV" >&2
  fi
  rm -f "$TMP"
fi
# export NODE_ENV=development in current shell only if not set
: "${NODE_ENV:=}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
: ${NODE_ENV:="development"}
export NODE_ENV
# echo detected versions for automation evidence
echo "node=${NODE_V} npm=${NPM_V}"

steps.name: validation
steps.description: Validation: ensure dependencies are installed, start the app on PORT (respect PORT env var or default 3000), poll /health until responsive, capture server log to /tmp/backend_server.log, run tests, then attempt graceful shutdown (SIGTERM, wait, SIGKILL if needed). Produce concise evidence: node/npm versions, npm ci exit code summary, test pass/fail result, and tail of server log.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="${WORKSPACE:-/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/two-player-tic-tac-toe-30439-30448/backend}"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
export NODE_ENV="${NODE_ENV:-development}"
PORT="${PORT:-3000}"
TIMEOUT_SECONDS=${VALIDATION_TIMEOUT:-20}
LOG=/tmp/backend_server.log
rm -f "$LOG"
NODE_V=$(node -v || true) && NPM_V=$(npm -v || true)
# ensure dependencies
if ! node -e "require('express')" >/dev/null 2>&1; then npm ci --silent --no-audit --no-fund; NPM_CI_STATUS=$?; else NPM_CI_STATUS=0; fi
echo "node=${NODE_V} npm=${NPM_V} npm_ci_status=${NPM_CI_STATUS}"
# start server in background
node index.js >"$LOG" 2>&1 &
PID=$!
case "$PID" in
  ''|*[!0-9]*) echo "failed to start server (invalid PID)" >&2; tail -n 200 "$LOG"; exit 6 ;;
esac
trap 'if [ -n "${PID:-}" ] && ps -p "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then kill -TERM "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; sleep 2; if ps -p "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then kill -KILL "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi; fi' EXIT
# poll /health; prefer bound PORT; try both 127.0.0.1 and localhost
END=$((SECONDS + TIMEOUT_SECONDS))
HEALTH_OK=0
while [ $SECONDS -le $END ]; do
  for host in 127.0.0.1 localhost; do
    if curl -sS --fail "http://$host:$PORT/health" >/dev/null 2>&1; then HEALTH_OK=1; break 2; fi
  done
  sleep 0.2
done
if [ $HEALTH_OK -ne 1 ]; then echo "validation failed: /health not reachable on port $PORT" >&2; echo "server log:"; tail -n 200 "$LOG"; exit 7; fi
echo "validation ok: /health responded on port $PORT"
# run tests (already depend on test step but run to collect evidence)
TEST_STATUS=0
if command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then npm test --silent --no-audit --no-fund || TEST_STATUS=$?; fi
# graceful shutdown
if ps -p "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then kill -TERM "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; sleep 2; if ps -p "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then kill -KILL "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi; fi
wait "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true
# evidence summary
echo "--- evidence ---"
echo "node=${NODE_V} npm=${NPM_V} npm_ci_status=${NPM_CI_STATUS} test_status=${TEST_STATUS}"
echo "--- server log (tail 200 lines) ---"
tail -n 200 "$LOG" || true
trap - EXIT
if [ ${TEST_STATUS:-0} -ne 0 ]; then echo 'tests failed' >&2; exit 8; fi
exit 0
